Command.Comment: RAGIN EDGE live negative mTLS wrong-identity probe (no secrets)

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
CA_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/ca.crt
WRONG_CERT=/etc/ragin/tls/server.crt
WRONG_KEY=/etc/ragin/tls/server.key
echo CA_FILE="$CA_FILE"
echo WRONG_CERT="$WRONG_CERT"
echo WRONG_KEY="$WRONG_KEY"
CERTS_READY=0
if [ -n "$CA_FILE" ] && [ -n "$WRONG_CERT" ] && [ -n "$WRONG_KEY" ] && [ -f "$CA_FILE" ] && [ -f "$WRONG_CERT" ] && [ -f "$WRONG_KEY" ]; then
  CERTS_READY=1
fi
echo CERTS_READY=$CERTS_READY
echo WRONG_IDENTITY_PREVIEW_BEGIN
openssl x509 -noout -subject -ext subjectAltName,extendedKeyUsage,keyId,authorityKeyIdentifier \
  -in "$WRONG_CERT" 2>/dev/null || echo WRONG_CERT_PARSE_FAILED
echo WRONG_IDENTITY_PREVIEW_END
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
echo TMPDIR=$TMPDIR
if [ "$CERTS_READY" = "1" ] && command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "CASE_WRONG_IDENTITY_CERT"
  if openssl s_client -connect 172.31.17.217:8443 \
    -CAfile "$CA_FILE" \
    -cert "$WRONG_CERT" \
    -key "$WRONG_KEY" \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "${TMPDIR}/case_wrong_identity.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo CASE_WRONG_IDENTITY_EXIT=0
  else
    echo CASE_WRONG_IDENTITY_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo CASE_WRONG_IDENTITY_HEAD_BEGIN
  head -n 80 "${TMPDIR}/case_wrong_identity.txt"
  echo CASE_WRONG_IDENTITY_HEAD_END
else
  echo WRONG_IDENTITY_CASE_SKIPPED=no_certs_or_no_openssl
fi
rm -rf "${TMPDIR}"
echo DONE
